viva_explanation.mae: Mean Absolute Error measures the average magnitude of prediction errors in rupees. An MAE of ₹8.5 Lakhs means predictions typically deviate by around ₹8.5 Lakhs from actual transaction values.
viva_explanation.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error gives extra weight to large prediction deviations because errors are squared before averaging. Useful for detecting severe outlier misvaluations.
viva_explanation.r2: R-squared (85.5%) indicates what percentage of the variance in property prices across Mumbai/MMR is successfully explained by physical specifications, location, amenities, and transit distances.
